note: Six-layer J802 SimpleRouteJson board (spec/formats/srj.md). 15 declared connections; required-connection count is 15 (Q-68 ruling (b), rules/connectivity.md K-13..K-15). violations.maxAdded 0 is hard (R-1); violations.preExisting 0 is hard: the reference loads 0 violations because Prior copper is DRC-silent among itself (formats/srj.md J-33, rules/drc.md DR-13). This board carries seven GND-owned pads that cover declared endpoints and whose owner matches no routed connection: a faithful import refuses it (formats/srj.md J-25), and it routes only under the context-net reading. Those GND pads are Prior copper and are silent against other Prior copper, so a reading that spacing-checks Prior-vs-Prior over-reports before routing and fails this metric. It is also a congestion board: at a 60 s budget the sealed reference joined 0 of 15, but under a generous budget (up to 500 passes / 300 s / 30 stagnant passes, S9) it joined 1 of 15 (incomplete 14) in about 248 s without exhausting the budget. The incomplete bound is advisory and relaxed to the best observed value, 14 (non-gating): the reference's completion depends on attaching to Prior copper (K-16), which a coarse router without that capability cannot reach (it stays at 15). Reference numbers: spec/acceptance/reference/b223-j802-six-layer.srj.default.json (60 s) and spec/acceptance/reference/b223-j802-six-layer.srj.bound.json (generous budget).
